A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Model Merging in the Essential Subspace and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A-C. The complete material supports comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original ESM experiments on three CLIP backbones, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, timing measurements, and out-of-domain evaluations.

after.justification: v2 retains the original ESM benchmark experiments, ablations, timing measurements, and appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 newly states that eigenvalue-based weighting is applied to Pcat and Acat before SVD; v1 describes orthogonalization without this step. However, the equations and Appendix Algorithm 1 remain unchanged and omit this weighting. The PDFs do not establish whether this revises the procedure or discloses a previously omitted implementation detail.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same 8-, 14-, and 20-task datasets, ImageNet-1k proxy-data scenario, single-class proxy sampling, and leave-one-task-out evaluation in Appendix C.1.

E2.justification: Removing v1 Figure 1 removes the standalone LiNeS comparison on the three ViT-B/32 benchmarks. The distinct ESM-plus-LiNeS comparison remains in v2 Figure 8, and Table 1 retains all its comparators. Newly cited DC-Merge is not added to the evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Reported evaluation settings remain unchanged: the three CLIP backbones, checkpoint sources, absolute and normalized accuracy, proxy-sample configurations, validation-based scaling selection, and appendix testing procedures are retained.

E4.justification: The ESD/PS ablations, loading-order analyses, feature-preservation comparisons, proxy-data robustness tests, and LiNeS scaling analysis are retained. Appendices also preserve pairwise task interaction, OOD evaluation, scaling-order, rank, and exponent analyses.

E5.justification: Table 4 retains the same uncertainty reporting and five-run description. The proxy-size experiment also retains five random runs and individual-run displays. No new statistical estimation or significance testing is reported.

E6.justification: Deleting v1 Figure 1 removes standalone LiNeS accuracies of 77.6, 73.6, and 68.6 for the 8-, 14-, and 20-task ViT-B/32 benchmarks. Numerical results in Tables 1-8 and the matched remaining plots are unchanged; no same-setting performance improvement is reported.

T1.justification: Equations 1-31 and Appendix A's three theorems and proofs are retained, including the activation-centering assumption and whitening/Procrustes equivalence. The added weighting prose introduces no new formal definition or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about feature-aware essential subspaces, three-level polarized scaling, reduced interference, and state-of-the-art merging performance.

C2.justification: Section 3.2 adds the mechanism explanation that eigenvalue weighting preferentially preserves important directions during orthogonalization. Interpretations of norm-based consensus, proxy robustness, and generalization otherwise remain unchanged, with no new substantive limitations.

D1.justification: The abstract adds a code-repository address absent from v1. Section 3.2 newly documents pre-SVD eigenvalue weighting, although no explicit weighting formula is supplied. Existing hardware, timings, hyperparameters, and appendix implementation details are retained.

R1.justification: v2 removes the model-alignment discussion and associated references, including Git Re-Basin and REPAIR, and drops the Layer Normalization reference. It adds DC-Merge, a LoRA application, and three Learngene references while broadening Section 2.2 to weight transformation and knowledge transfer. The central positioning against SVD-based merging remains.

P1.justification: Related-work paragraphs are locally rewritten, Section 2.2 is renamed from Model Weight Decomposition to Model Weight Transformation, and an acknowledgment is added. Other wording changes and the orthogonalization explanation are limited; the overall narrative structure remains.

P2.justification: v1's opening benchmark chart is removed. The ESD schematic moves from page 4 to page 3, subsequent figures are renumbered, and the scaling-coefficient plots are made taller without changing their data. Tables and other graphics retain their structure.

improvement.justification: The code-access information and additional weighting explanation improve documentation, but v2 removes the standalone LiNeS evidence and leaves the weighting statement unreconciled with unchanged equations and Algorithm 1. Main results and proofs otherwise remain stable. These limited benefits and losses, together with unresolved procedural clarity, do not establish a reliable net direction in overall quality.
